entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I need to return my new VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Chen. Order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. Pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 2nd. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's not working at all. I charged it fully, but it just won't sync with the app on my phone. I've followed all the steps, but nothing happens. I think the one I got is just broken.
Okay, so it sounds like the device may be defective. I understand how frustrating that must be when you're excited to start using a new product.
It really is. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and saved up for this. I really needed this money if it wasn't going to work as advertised. I just feel let down.
I completely understand, Alex, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed our policy, and since your item was delivered 23 days ago, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can go ahead and cannot offer a refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I'd be stuck with a broken device.

Not at all. I'm happy to resolve this for you. I'm processing the return now and have just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued.
That's wonderful. You've been a huge help. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
